title: Privacy First
message: Please do not enter your name, phone number, address, Aadhaar number, email address, medical record number or other identifying information.
rules: Collect only information necessary for health navigation.
Do not request unnecessary personal information.
Do not repeat identifying information in generated summaries.
Clearly explain that the application is not a diagnostic tool.
Encourage users to consult qualified healthcare professionals.
disclaimer: This AI provides health education and navigation, not diagnosis or treatment. It cannot replace a qualified healthcare professional.
